# LLM Engineer
Tidewell · Full-time

What you'll do

- Prototype and ship agent features for small-business accounting.
- Write evaluation sets and run them on every change.

Requirements

- New grads welcome: projects count.
- Strong Python.
- You have built something with LLMs and can show it.
- Experience writing evals for model outputs.

Nice to have

- Experience with vector databases such as pgvector.
- Docker.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Tidewell is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
